# Results — Study 07 (Coiled-Spring) on the cached liquid universe

*Generated by [`examples/verify_real.py`](../examples/verify_real.py). Universe: the cached
deep-history US names (split-only prices — see the data-mode note in
[`coiled_spring/data.py`](../coiled_spring/data.py)). Rule: 20-EMA pivot breakout, pivot =
local high over ±3 bars after a spell below the EMA, pullback must **hold
the EMA in close**, breakout = first close above the pivot on **volume ≥ 2×** the
trailing 20-day average; enter next open, stop under the breakout bar's low,
trail under the prior bar's low in profit, 30-session max hold.
Round-trip cost **15 bps**. As-of **2026-06-01**. Price fingerprint **`42590aa02dc9`**
(174 names, 1962-01-02 → 2026-06-01).*

> **Machinery sanity first.** On the offline synthetic universe (planted springboards hidden
> among random walks) the detector recalls **52%** of planted breakouts
> (84/162) and the backtest harvests their runs — so the
> rule *fires and pays where the structure is really there*. Whatever the real data says
> below is therefore the market talking, not a broken detector.

## The "explosive move" audit
The book sells the rule on +30-50% pops in 6-10 days. Across **all** 1674
trades, the share that gross **≥ +30%** is **1.7%**;
the median net trade is **-0.25%** and the average hold
is **3** sessions.
